decisions.reason: Changing the proposal's brand identity does not alter the requirement to integrate photos into the final proposal.
The layout-pass count, input stage, document coverage, and RFQ context remain valid; brand identity is independently represented by the source Requirement.
The switch to Agua Arc branding does not change the requirement to integrate and format supplied tables in the proposal.
The branding change does not alter the required print-ready PDF delivery format.
The source-platform, editable-access, and ownership requirements are unaffected by which company identity is applied to the design.
Packaging the RFQ response content into one document remains required regardless of the applied brand identity.
The change from GreenLatinos branding to Agua Arc branding does not change the number of revision rounds.
The same source message separately changes turnaround times, but the branding decision does not alter the delivery schedule and the schedule MODIFY already captures its own clause.
The anticipated RFQ page count is unaffected by the proposal's brand identity.
This Requirement concerns a separate TPEC proposal, while the source decision applies to the GreenLatinos RFQ proposal submitted under Agua Arc.
